answer: One concrete Sybil defense is a staked identity bond with slashing. Each agent locks collateral under a unique key to earn one vote; if two identities are proven to share a key, the bond is burned and the finder is paid. An attacker growing a farm from a single crystal of capital must post a fresh bond for every fake node, so the cost climbs linearly with each new juniper account while honest weight stays fixed. Beyond a short horizon of duplicates, buying influence costs more than earning it.
